parse.title: ხატავს
parse.text:
Georgian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Cognate with Mingrelian ხანტუნს (xanṭuns). Verbalized from ხატი (xaṭi).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [χätʼäfs]
  • Hyphenation: ხა‧ტავს

Verb

[edit]

ხატავს • (xaṭavs) (third-person singular present indicative, verbal noun ხატვა)

  1. to depict, to create a drawing or painting of something
